name: Cursor
shortDescription: Desktop IDE with an agent that can edit, run, and review code.
longDescription: Cursor is a desktop IDE whose agent edits and reviews code. The pricing page lists a $0 tier next to paid plans.
pricingNotes: Paid plans present; confirm current inclusions on cursor.com/pricing.
freeTierNotes: Limited agent requests and limited chat requests.
bestFor: Developers who want an agent inside the editor
Day-to-day coding where the agent should touch the repo
notIdealFor: A headless library you import from Python
A hands-on install check — we did not run one
strength: The free plan includes limited agent and chat requests in a desktop IDE that can edit the repo.
weakness: The free plan caps agent and chat requests, and the pricing page we fetched did not state a clear lowest monthly price.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.coding-agents: Desktop IDE agent that can edit the repo, with a free plan of limited requests.
